title: Anthropic's founders seek voting control ahead of IPO | TechCrunch
summary: There are twists, too: Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust would still choose most of the board; the founders’ board seats would grow from two to three; and employees would get their own stock to break ties on some issues.
